meta.name: add-teams
meta.description: Add Microsoft Teams channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.tagline: 集成 Microsoft Teams 频道到你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用中添加 Teams 消息通知功能
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Microsoft Teams channels into your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add Teams messaging to your application

howto.what: 为项目接入 Microsoft Teams 渠道：从 channels 分支复制 Teams 适配器并注册，安装 @chat-adapter/teams，跑构建与注册测试，再用 Teams CLI 创建机器人并把凭证写入 .env。
howto.when: 当你要求给助手接入 Microsoft Teams 渠道时触发；需已有可创建 Entra 应用并侧载的 Microsoft 365 账号，以及指向本机 3000 端口的 HTTPS 端点。

say.text: 给助手接入 Microsoft Teams 渠道。
say.note: 会复制适配器、装依赖并走建机器人流程。

say.text: 帮我用 Teams CLI 创建一个叫 NanoClaw 的机器人。
say.note: 注册 Entra 应用与机器人，并给出安装链接。

say.text: 我的隧道地址变了，帮我更新机器人的 endpoint。
say.note: 用 teams app update 更新，不用重建应用。

howto.what_en: Adds a Microsoft Teams channel: copies the Teams adapter from the channels branch, registers it, installs @chat-adapter/teams, builds and tests it, then uses the Teams CLI to create a bot and write credentials to .env.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to add Microsoft Teams as a channel; needs a Microsoft 365 tenant that can sideload apps and an HTTPS endpoint forwarding to port 3000 on this machine.

say_en.text: Add Microsoft Teams as a channel for my assistant.
say_en.note: Copies the adapter, installs deps, then runs bot setup.

say_en.text: Create a Teams bot named NanoClaw with the Teams CLI.
say_en.note: Registers the Entra app and bot, returns an install link.

say_en.text: My tunnel URL changed - update the bot endpoint.
say_en.note: Runs teams app update instead of recreating the app.
